exposure.needed: the config location and exact key name of the PackageRuntime setting (Helm values key, CLI flag, or feature gate), so environments that set it can be detected

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 splits the single PackageRuntime setting into separate settings for functions and providers, so the combined setting no longer exists, per a one-line release note that does not name the new settings, say where PackageRuntime is configured, or state what happens to existing configurations.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The release note names only a "PackageRuntime setting"; it does not say whether that setting is a Helm values key, CLI flag, feature gate, or CRD/config field, and no artifact context pins its exact key, so its identity cannot be pinned.; consequence: The release note does not state what happens to environments that set the old PackageRuntime setting — whether the old key is ignored, rejected, or maps onto the new per-type settings.
